parameters.name: IncludeMediaInfo
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include the media information in the response.

- Valid values: true and false.

- Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: IncludePlayList
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include the playback information in the response.

- Valid values: true and false.

- Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: IncludeSnapshotList
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include the snapshot information in the response.

- Valid values: true and false.

- Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: IncludeSummaryList
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include the summary in the response.

- Valid values: true and false.

- Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: MediaIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the media files to query. To obtain the media IDs, log on to the MPS console and go to **Media Management** > **Media List**. Separate multiple IDs with a comma (,). You can query a maximum of 10 media files at a time.
